name.description: Target name. Used for `glugent build <name>` and the default output file name.

output.description: Output file path, relative to the config file. Default: <outDir>/<name>.md

props.description: Props applied to every section of this target.

sections.description: Sections to glue together, in order.

oneOf.description: Section id (path without extension, or a unique path suffix).
